audience: health-tech teams that pull medical records through Metriport

useCases.title: Review the facilities and their patients
useCases.text: The AI lists the facilities of your organization and the patients registered at one facility.

useCases.title: Check which documents are available for a patient
useCases.text: The AI lists the documents of one patient and the progress of the latest document query. You see what arrived and what is still loading.

useCases.title: Open a document or the record summary
useCases.text: The AI gets a temporary download link for a chosen document, or a link to the medical record summary as PDF or HTML.

useCases.title: Request new records for a patient
useCases.text: The AI starts a document query and a consolidated data query for one patient. Results arrive later. It asks for your OK first.
